Title: Aditya and the Family

Cast

1. Aditya - 10 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Kavya - 11 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Sunita - 36 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Karan - 39 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Aditya stands in the living room. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "Let's do something fun today."

[Aditya eats his breakfast at the table.]

Sunita: "Let's see."

[Aditya takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Aditya: "How beautiful!"

[Aditya munches on an apple.]

Aditya: "Careful!"

[Aditya drinks a glass of water.]

Sunita: "Hey, look at that!"

[Aditya gulps down a glass of milk.]

Aditya: "One more time!"

[Aditya serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Aditya: "One more time!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Karan: "So, here we are!"

[A dust storm sweeps across the village.]

Aditya: "How beautiful!"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Aditya (laughing): "That's easy."

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Aditya: "Hmm, I see."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Thick fog lies all around. Aditya stands in the courtyard. Sunita and Karan stand near him.]

Aditya: "What a nice place."

[The mist slowly clears.]

Aditya: "Careful!"

Scene 4: The park - Day

[Aditya stands in the park. Kavya, Sunita and Karan stand near him.]

Sunita: "What a nice place."

[Aditya does push-ups.]

Kavya: "How beautiful!"

[Aditya does yoga on a mat.]

Karan: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Kavya skips rope.]

Sunita: "That was such a fun day!"
